description: Holds travel type records (defined in the EF Core model).
business_purpose: Used to track and report travel type records for the HR & User Management area.
record_granularity: One row represents one travel type.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the travel type.

columns.name: Created_ById
columns.description: User who created the travel type.

columns.name: Created_Date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: Is_Deleted
columns.description: Soft-delete flag. True when the record has been deleted.

columns.name: Modified_ById
columns.description: User who last modified the travel type.

columns.name: Modified_Date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was last modified.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Free-text description for the travel type.

columns.name: travel_type
columns.description: Travel type of the travel type.
